# Kaichen Power - Diesel Generator Sets Manufacturer

> Jiangsu Kaichen Power Equipment Co., Ltd. is a professional diesel generator sets manufacturer based in Yangzhou, China. We design and produce diesel generator sets ranging from 20 kVA to 2000 kVA, including silent type, open type, containerized and trailer-mounted generators. We use Cummins, Weichai, Yuchai, SDEC and Perkins engines, paired with high-quality alternators.

## Products
- [Cummins Silent Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/cummins/) - 20kW to 500kW silent diesel generators powered by Cummins engines
- [Weichai Silent Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/category/weichai/) - 20kW to 300kW silent diesel generators powered by Weichai engines
- [Open Type Diesel Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - Open frame diesel generator sets for industrial use
- [Containerized Generators](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/products/) - Containerized generator solutions for outdoor applications

## Applications
- [Industrial Power Solutions](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/industrial/) - Backup and prime power for factories and industrial facilities
- [Commercial Building Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/commercial/) - Reliable standby power for hotels, hospitals and commercial buildings
- [Construction Site Power](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/construction/) - Mobile power solutions for construction sites
- [Telecom Power Solutions](https://www.dgsetmanufacturer.com/en/solutions/telecom/) - 24/7 reliable power for telecom base stations

## Specifications
- Power range: 20 kVA - 3000 kVA
- Engine brands: Cummins, Weichai, Yuchai, SDEC, Perkins
- Voltage: 220V - 11kV (single phase and three phase)
- Frequency: 50 Hz / 60 Hz
- Noise level: 65-75 dB(A) at 7 meters (silent type)
- Certification: CE, ISO 9001
- Export markets: Southeast Asia, Middle East, Africa, South America, Eastern Europe
